Order 
Inherent powers of this Court are invoked under Section 482 Cr.P.C./528 of BNSS, 2023 for a direction to delete condition No.7 subject to which the petitioner was admitted to bail vide order dated 19.05.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.No.21562/2025 in respect offences punishable under Sections 406, 420 of IPC.
2. The condition No.7 read thus :-
"(vii) The applicant shall appear before the concerned police station once in every fortnight till conclusion of trial."
3. It is submitted by the counsel for the petitioner that the petitioner has been regularly complying with the aforesaid condition.

However, since the petitioner is engaged in earning his livelihood in Indore and is required to attend his work on a daily basis to support his family, compliance with the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:217 2 MCRC-58769-2025 said condition has become impracticable.
It is therefore prayed that Condition No. 7 be deleted.
4. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer.

sentences.text:
Having considered the submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and taking into account the fact that the petitioner is a permanent resident of Indore and already admitted to bail,
this Court is of the opinion that compliance with condition No.7 would cause undue hardship to the petitioner.
The purpose of ensuring his availability during trial can sufficiently be served by adhering to other conditions already imposed.
Condition No.7 imposed in order dated 19.05.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.No.21562/2025 stands deleted.
He shall appear before the Trial Court on all the dates, which may be given by the same in this behalf.
7. Remaining part of the order shall remain intact.

This order shall be read in conjunction with the order dated 19.05.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.No.21562/2025.
8.
With the aforesaid directions, the present petition stands disposed of.
